blocks.title: Decision making
blocks.text: Decision making program ko sharait ki bunyad par mukhtalif amal chunne deti hai, jaise log asal zindagi mein faisle karte hain. Python is ke liye kai conditional statements deti hai.
Statements yeh hain: if, if-else, short-hand if-else, if-elif-else aur nested conditionals. Shart koi bhi aisa expression hai jo True ya False ho, jaise temperature > 30.

blocks.prompt: if statement ki shart ko kis qism ki qeemat deni chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Boolean qeemat, True ya False, aam taur par comparison ya logical expression se.

items: Decision making: if, if-else, short-hand, if-elif-else aur nesting se True/False sharait par amal chunna.
